goal: Drop invalid Taproot and MuSig2 signatures when an input is added to a PSBT
Prevent operations like joinpsbts from emitting transactions carrying stale signatures
agreement: Concept support because it clears all signature fields and MuSig2 nonces as expected (fametrano)
Approval without stated rationale from an account with no prior project history (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: rpc
